strategy_roster.name: Chandel Exit Re-Entry
strategy_roster.notes: Chandelier-style bands are approximated by 22-bar Donchian bounds shifted by 3 ATR(10), preserving the docs' unusual bullish lower-over-upper cross. Range/ATR/multiplier values are fallbacks; signal-bar delay, additions, and point protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: 2526 TDI-2 Re-Open
strategy_roster.notes: A MACD(20,50) line versus EMA(9) cross is an explicit momentum/index proxy for TDI-2; 20 is the documented period and 50/9 are fallbacks. Re-entry ladders, SignalBar, H4 timing, and 1000/2000-point protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Zonal Trading Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(5,34) is an AO proxy and its SMA(5) difference is the AC proxy; rising changes for both enter, and either falling change exits. Exact Awesome/Accelerator formulas and H4 streams are approximated, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Divergence MACD Stochastic
strategy_roster.entry_long: low < donchian_low_prev(low,10) and macd(close,12,26) - macd_signal(close,12,26,9) > 0 and rsi(close,14) < 30
strategy_roster.notes: A new 10-bar low with a positive MACD(12,26,9) histogram and RSI(14)<30 approximates bullish histogram divergence plus oversold Stochastic; the swing length and oscillator threshold are fallbacks. Exact paired swing storage, Stochastic 50/9 filters, and 50-step protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Tengri Strategy (StockSharp Port)
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,20) and rsi(close,14) < 70 and atr(high,low,close,14) < sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20), RSI(14)<70, and ATR(14) below its 20-bar mean approximate the trend gauge and two quiet-market filters. Higher-timeframe open bias, exact Silence levels, grid spacing, martingale sizing, profit locks, and clock controls are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: LazyBot V1
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar high break approximates the previous daily range's offset buy stop; Donchian length is an explicit fallback because no numeric trading defaults are supplied. Daily scheduling, spread/hour filters, pip trailing, and risk sizing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: TCPivotStop Floor Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20) is an explicit proxy for the prior-day floor pivot crossed on the available series. Exact H/L/C pivot tiers, selected support/resistance target, session reset, and stop logic are unavailable; no numeric stop/target is supplied.

strategy_roster.name: ESG Factor Momentum
strategy_roster.notes: Positive documented 252-day momentum is a single-ticker proxy for holding the cross-sectional winner, with negative momentum as rebalance liquidation. ESG scoring, monthly first-day timing, universe ranking, and minimum USD size are unavailable; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: iTrade
strategy_roster.notes: The manager opens shorts only after explicit button requests, so no long signal is fabricated. Ticket accounting, martingale sizing, bid/ask floating profit, timers, and best/worst-position liquidation require unsupported portfolio state.

strategy_roster.name: Hurst Exponent Volatility Filter
strategy_roster.entry_long: zscore(roc(close,10),100) < -1 and roc(roc(close,10),1) > 0 and atr(high,low,close,14) < 1.5 * sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20)
strategy_roster.notes: A normalized ten-bar momentum reversal with ATR(14) below 1.5 times its 20-bar mean proxies Hurst exhaustion and the volatility filter; HurstPeriod=100 is retained. Hurst estimation and unspecified thresholds are approximated; 2% is the documented stop.
